description: An Ed25519 private key whose d (RFC 8037 Appendix A.1) does not derive its x (the RFC 8032 §7.1 TEST 2 public key 3d4017c3…f4660c, itself a valid key) is rejected at import (ADR 0043 §3, amending ADR 0041 §4; RFC 8037 §2, RFC 8032 §5.1.5; the class behind RUSTSEC-2022-0093). Derived independently of polyjose with the RFC 8032 §5.1.5 key derivation in pure Python (hashlib SHA-512 and Edwards arithmetic): the A.1 d derives the A.1 x 11qYAYKx…cHURo, not this x
